newsitem.title: CHINA: China to consider more foreign insurance firms.
newsitem.headline: China to consider more foreign insurance firms.

text.p: China is considering allowing more foreign insurance companies to sell policies on the domestic market, the China Securities Newspaper said on Saturday.

The central bank is drafting regulations under which the number of foreign insurance companies operating in China could be increased, the paper quoted a senior official of the central bank as saying. It gave no further details.
Only two foreign insurance companies are currently allowed to issue insurance policies in China -- American International Assurance of the United States and Japan's Tokio Marine and Fire Insurance.
